title: The Einstein of Sex (HKLGFF 2026)
synopsis: Long before Kinsey, there was Magnus Hirschfeld: physician, sexologist, socialist, Jew, homosexual, and the man the tabloids dubbed "the Einstein of Sex." Rosa von Praunheim's affectionate biopic charts Hirschfeld's extraordinary crusade as he founds the world's first gay rights organisation in 1897, battles Paragraph 175, and opens Berlin's pioneering Institute for Sexual Science in 1920, a haven for queer and trans lives that flourished through the Weimar years until Nazi students torched its library in 1933. Friedel von Wangenheim plays the doctor with owlish warmth, flanked by his aristocratic great love Baron von Teschenberg, devoted young Karl Giese, and the institute's guardian angel, housekeeper Dorchen. Mixing period drama, newsreel and von Praunheim's trademark impish humour, it is both a monument to a man the Nazis nearly erased from history and a reminder of how quickly hard-won progress can burn.
